name: cp2_october10_2026
eligibility: Every unique matched paid service in the unchanged frozen predictor population with Calendar start date 10–27 October. Unmatched/ambiguous/source-excluded appointments are tracked separately and never silently treated as eligible services or completed predictions.
prediction_timing: Daytime: within five minutes after scheduled end. Overnight: within five minutes after 23:45 Malaysia time on the scheduled start date, using only information available then. Overnight scores concern a planned service and may precede its start. Never score after the first local outcome day begins.
outcome_window: Unchanged: Calendar callback dates 1–30 after the scheduled START date; never move the clock to the end date.
acceptance: Complete Calendar outcomes, stable eligibility, and one timely source-bound immutable prediction for every eligible service; reject incomplete coverage, altered protocol/model/source, or repeat evaluation.
prior_cohorts: All original protocols, predictions, missed timestamps and results remain unchanged; this prospective timing change does not repair them.
limitations: Predictions are experimental. Later cancellations or schedule/source changes require eligibility-drift review. External outages can still cause gaps. Overnight timing differs from the historical post-service collection contract; report its results separately.
